map.由剩余碳-14 比例推算样品年代。: Infer the age of a sample from the remaining carbon-14 fraction.
map.t = T½/ln2 · ln(N₀/N)。 剩 50% 即一个半衰期。: t = T½/ln2 · ln(N₀/N). A remaining 50% means one half-life.
map.t = (th/ln2)·ln(1/frac) 由残留比例求样本年龄。: t = (th/ln2)·ln(1/frac) gives the sample age from the remaining fraction.
map.对比不同残留比例的年代。: Compare ages for different remaining fractions.
map.若 frac=0.25，则 t≈8267×ln(4)=8267×1.386≈11: If frac=0.25, then t ≈ 8267 x ln(4) = 8267 x 1.386 ≈ 11460 years, two half-lives.
map.C-14 半衰期 5730 年，有效定年通常约 5 万年内，过老信号太弱。: With a C-14 half-life of 5730 years, effective dating usually reaches about 50 000 years; beyond that the signal is too weak.
map.测样品现存 C-14 活度与初始（大气）活度之比得到残留比例。: Measure the ratio of the sample's current C-14 activity to the initial atmospheric activity to get the remaining fraction.
